steps.decide: Which destinations are primary and what the one action the bar exists to reach is
Collapse threshold: how many items survive at 768/1024 before an overflow menu appears
Current-page signalling that does not rely on colour alone
Sticky or static, and what it costs in reading space

rules.statement: The bar carries at most one visually dominant action; a second primary action makes both secondary.
Items are removed at the breakpoint where labels truncate, not where the design feels tight; the collapsed form is a menu, not smaller text.
The overflow menu is reachable and dismissable by keyboard alone, with Escape returning focus to the trigger.
The current destination carries a non-colour cue (weight, rule or position) in addition to colour.
The built bar keeps the page at or above the measured no-skill baseline floor for its surface.

transitions.trigger: Enter or Space on the destination

motion.noneReason: navigation is immediate; animating a page change costs a frame for no information
the new document starts at its own default state

stateMachine.staleResponseRule: the collapsed menu closes on route change, but a late close must not close a menu the user has reopened

sections.intent: Let a visitor reach any primary destination in one action while keeping the current location obvious.
useCases: Docs sidebar replacement on narrow viewports
nicheDifferences: Documentation sites need a sidebar equivalent, not a marketing bar
Admin consoles need an account/tenant switcher inside the bar
inputs: Breakpoint widths in the design system
Whether the page scrolls under the bar
styling: One dominant action only; everything else recedes
Current destination marked by weight or rule, not hue alone
Height stays constant between states to avoid shift
a11y: Overflow menu is keyboard operable with Escape returning focus
responsive: Collapse at the width labels truncate, not earlier
Collapsed bar keeps the primary action visible
copy: Destination labels are nouns the user recognises, not internal codenames
Overflow trigger reads Menu, not More stuff
alternatives: A sidebar is preferable when destinations exceed seven
A tab bar suits three or fewer peers with equal weight

acceptance: Every destination reachable by keyboard in two actions or fewer
Current page identifiable with CSS disabled
